title: Application to qualified foreign corporations.
bodyText: A foreign corporation authorized to transact business in this State on July 1, 2002 shall be subject to this chapter but is not required to obtain a new certificate of authority to transact business under this chapter.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: "July 1, 2002" substituted for "the effective date of this chapter".

bodyHtml:
[§414D-322]  Application to qualified foreign corporations.  A foreign corporation authorized to transact business in this State on July 1, 2002 shall be subject to this chapter but is not required to obtain a new certificate of authority to transact business under this chapter. [L 2001, c 105, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  "July 1, 2002" substituted for "the effective date of this chapter".
